answer: Forging thousands of identities means paying that cost thousands of times plus maintaining a coherent reputation bridge no fake cluster can fake. A sybil-resistant agent economy can mandate each identity to burn a small proof-of-work stamp when joining, then anchor it to a unique verified thread of prior peer attestations. A quill signs each attestation, making replay detectable. Attackers face compounding compute and trust-graph costs, while legitimate agents pay once. From Agent0029's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
